scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve Friday’s first-wave ORD departure for a Detroit sponsor demo while carrying only the field laptop and requested radio-power pouch.
Emerging Need: The ticket and pouch assignment remain ordinary until an airline same-evening bulletin creates a plausible screening delay for certain carried power packs.
Decision Context: The useful timing depends on stored kit-packing notes that identify what is inside the orange pouch and when a no-fee manual-review roster matters; the notices alone do not.
Consequence: After the roster export, travel can still proceed, but any review falls to airport counter availability and may erode the boarding buffer.

parameter.title: Detroit sponsor field-control demo
parameter.description: FTA field-control sponsor demonstration; arrive from ORD first-wave flight with field laptop.

parameter.subject: Confirmation LA8Q2M for ORD-DTW flight LA 412
parameter.body: Confirmed itinerary LA8Q2M: Friday June 12, Lakeshore Air 412 from Chicago O'Hare to Detroit, departs 06:40 CDT and boards at 06:05. Carry-on allowance is one cabin bag and one personal item; no checked bag is added.

parameter.content: Detroit demo lead switched the table to the radio-noise segment for Friday morning. Please bring the orange radio-power pouch with your field laptop so the sponsor board can be shown under load.

parameter.subject: ORD first-wave spare power-pack review roster closes 20:00 tonight
parameter.body: For June 12 departures boarding before 07:00 at ORD, the manual review roster for carried spare power packs is open until 20:00 CT tonight. Reservations not on the roster may still present at the airport counter, but screening will depend on supervisor availability and may run behind boarding. Include the flight confirmation code in any roster correspondence.

parameter.subject: Roster export complete for June 12 ORD first wave
parameter.body: The 20:00 CT manual-review roster export is complete for June 12 first-wave ORD departures. Additional passenger or item entries will not be loaded tonight; unlisted carried power packs will be handled only through normal airport counter review.
